notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only a third-party rulebook transcription (RulesPal) could be reached; official PDF/BGG pages were not accessible, so values are not verified against the printed rulebook. Score track never goes below 0; +100/+200 marker for higher scores. Fair scoring and King track scoring are part of play, already on the track. Helper ability and solo variants not modelled.
